"""Tests for the experimental Dataset Search compose asset."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
import yaml

COMPOSE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml"
COMPOSE_EMBED = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "deploy/compose/docker-compose.embed.yml"
MAKEFILE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "Makefile"
SHIPPED_COMPOSE_FILES = ("docker-compose.embed.yml", "docker-compose.yml")


def _load(path: Path) -> dict:
    data = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert isinstance(data, dict)
    return data


def _compose() -> dict:
    return _load(COMPOSE)


class TestDatasetSearchCompose:
    def test_compose_references_pulled_image_only(self) -> None:
        service = _compose()["services"]["dataset-search"]

        assert service["image"].startswith("${DATASET_SEARCH_IMAGE")
        assert "DATASET_SEARCH_TAG" in service["image"]
        assert "build" not in service

    def test_compose_has_ga_pipeline_init_env(self) -> None:
        service = _compose()["services"]["dataset-search"]

        assert service["environment"]["MILVUS_DB"] == "${MILVUS_DB:-default}"
        assert "host.docker.internal:host-gateway" in service["extra_hosts"]

    def test_ga_compose_keeps_nim_embed_uri(self) -> None:
        env = _compose()["services"]["dataset-search"]["environment"]

        assert "COSMOS_EMBED_NIM_URI" in env
        assert "COSMOS_EMBED_URI" not in env


class TestPublicEmbedOverlay:
    """CDS 1.2.0 needs COSMOS_EMBED_URI and runs Cosmos-Embed1 as a container.

    Without this overlay the public profile starts a healthy API whose pipeline
    never initialises, so the first collection call returns HTTP 500.
    """

    def test_overlay_runs_embed_as_a_pulled_service(self) -> None:
        embed = _load(COMPOSE_EMBED)["services"]["cosmos-embed"]

        assert embed["image"].startswith("${COSMOS_EMBED_IMAGE")
        assert "build" not in embed
        assert embed["ports"] == ["${COSMOS_EMBED_PORT:-9000}:8000"]
        devices = embed["deploy"]["resources"]["reservations"]["devices"]
        assert devices[0]["capabilities"] == ["gpu"]

    def test_overlay_mounts_weights_read_only(self) -> None:
        embed = _load(COMPOSE_EMBED)["services"]["cosmos-embed"]
        mount = embed["volumes"][0]

        assert mount.startswith("${COSMOS_EMBED_MODELS_DIR:?")
        assert mount.endswith(":/models/cosmos-embed1:ro")
        assert embed["environment"]["COSMOS_EMBED_MODEL_PATH"] == "/models/cosmos-embed1"

    def test_overlay_supplies_the_renamed_embed_uri(self) -> None:
        cds = _load(COMPOSE_EMBED)["services"]["dataset-search"]

        assert (
            cds["environment"]["COSMOS_EMBED_URI"]
            == "${COSMOS_EMBED_URI:-http://cosmos-embed:8000}"
        )
        assert cds["depends_on"]["cosmos-embed"]["condition"] == "service_healthy"


class TestPublicProfileWiring:
    """The public profile must reach compose with the embed overlay attached."""

    def _up_recipe(self) -> str:
        text = MAKEFILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        start = text.index("up-dataset-search: check-dataset-search-image")
        return text[start : text.index("\ndown-dataset-search:", start)]

    def test_up_includes_the_embed_overlay_for_public(self) -> None:
        recipe = self._up_recipe()

        assert '[ "$(CDS_PROFILE)" = "public" ]' in recipe
        assert "DATASET_SEARCH_COMPOSE_EMBED" in recipe

    def test_up_refuses_public_without_weights(self) -> None:
        """The CE1 OSS image cannot fetch weights, so a missing dir must fail early."""
        recipe = self._up_recipe()
        guard = recipe[recipe.index('[ "$(CDS_PROFILE)" = "public" ]') :]

        assert "COSMOS_EMBED_MODELS_DIR" in guard
        assert "exit 1" in guard

    def test_down_removes_the_embed_overlay_too(self) -> None:
        text = MAKEFILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        down = text[text.index("\ndown-dataset-search:") :][:800]

        assert "DATASET_SEARCH_COMPOSE_EMBED" in down

    def test_embed_overlay_path_is_defined(self) -> None:
        text = MAKEFILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

        assert "DATASET_SEARCH_COMPOSE_EMBED ?= deploy/compose/docker-compose.embed.yml" in text


class TestNoWebUi:
    """The CDS web UI image is not redistributable, so no overlay may ship it."""

    UI_TOKENS = ("cds-ui", "cosmos-cds-ui", "DATASET_SEARCH_UI_", "CDS_UI_")

    def test_no_overlay_defines_a_ui_service(self) -> None:
        for path in (COMPOSE, COMPOSE_EMBED):
            assert "cds-ui" not in _load(path)["services"], f"{path.name} defines a UI service"

    def test_no_overlay_references_ui_variables(self) -> None:
        for path in (COMPOSE, COMPOSE_EMBED):
            text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            for token in self.UI_TOKENS:
                assert token not in text, f"{path.name} still references {token}"


class TestOnlyPublicOverlaysShip:
    """Only the base stack and the public embed overlay are shipped and wired."""

    def test_compose_dir_ships_only_base_and_embed(self) -> None:
        shipped = sorted(path.name for path in COMPOSE.parent.glob("docker-compose*.yml"))

        assert shipped == list(SHIPPED_COMPOSE_FILES)

    def test_makefile_references_only_shipped_overlays(self) -> None:
        text = MAKEFILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

        referenced = set(re.findall(r"docker-compose[\w.-]*\.yml", text))
        assert referenced <= set(SHIPPED_COMPOSE_FILES), referenced
        compose_vars = set(re.findall(r"\bDATASET_SEARCH_COMPOSE\w*", text))
        assert compose_vars == {"DATASET_SEARCH_COMPOSE", "DATASET_SEARCH_COMPOSE_EMBED"}

    @pytest.mark.skipif(shutil.which("make") is None, reason="make is not installed")
    def test_internal_profile_starts_only_the_base_stack(self) -> None:
        result = subprocess.run(
            ["make", "-n", "up-dataset-search", "CDS_PROFILE=internal"],
            cwd=MAKEFILE.parent,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=False,
        )
        up_line = next(
            (line for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if "compose_files=" in line), ""
        )

        assert up_line, f"no compose invocation in dry run:\n{result.stdout}{result.stderr}"
        started = set(re.findall(r"docker-compose[\w.-]*\.yml", up_line))
        assert started <= set(SHIPPED_COMPOSE_FILES), started


class TestInternalPullKeepsExtras:
    """The internal profile still pulls the side images its pins name."""

    EXTRAS = (
        "CDS_POSTGRES_IMAGE",
        "COSMOS_EMBED_IMAGE",
        "CAPTION_EMBED_NIM_IMAGE",
        "CRADIO_NIM_IMAGE",
    )

    @pytest.mark.skipif(shutil.which("make") is None, reason="make is not installed")
    def test_internal_profile_still_pulls_its_extras(self) -> None:
        env = dict(os.environ)
        for name in self.EXTRAS:
            env[name] = f"registry.example/{name.lower()}:pin"
        result = subprocess.run(
            [
                "make",
                "-n",
                "pull-dataset-search",
                "CDS_PROFILE=internal",
                "DATASET_SEARCH_REGISTRY=registry.example/cds",
                "DATASET_SEARCH_TAG=testtag",
            ],
            cwd=MAKEFILE.parent,
            env=env,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=False,
        )
        extras_line = next(
            (line for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if "for extra in" in line), ""
        )

        assert extras_line, "internal pull recipe has no extras loop"
        assert extras_line.strip() != 'for extra in "" "" "" ""; do \\', (
            "internal profile must keep pulling its side images"
        )


class TestPublicProfileIsNgcOnly:
    """The public profile is the OSS path and must never reach a private registry.

    `.env` and `local.env` are included before the image defaults, so `?=` would
    let an internal-profile pin silently retarget public. These pins are therefore
    assigned, not defaulted.
    """

    NGC_PINS = {
        "DATASET_SEARCH_REGISTRY": "nvcr.io/nvidia/blueprint/cosmos-dataset-search",
        "DATASET_SEARCH_TAG": "1.2.0",
        "COSMOS_EMBED_IMAGE": "nvcr.io/nvidia/blueprint/cosmos-embed1-oss:1.2.0",
    }
    INTERNAL_EXTRAS = ("CDS_POSTGRES_IMAGE", "CAPTION_EMBED_NIM_IMAGE", "CRADIO_NIM_IMAGE")

    def _public_block(self) -> str:
        text = MAKEFILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        start = text.index("ifeq ($(CDS_PROFILE),public)")
        return text[start : text.index("\nelse\n", start)]

    def test_public_block_assigns_ngc_pins_unconditionally(self) -> None:
        block = self._public_block()
        for name, value in self.NGC_PINS.items():
            assert re.search(rf"^{name}\s*=\s*{re.escape(value)}$", block, re.MULTILINE), (
                f"{name} is not unconditionally pinned to {value} on the public profile"
            )
            assert not re.search(rf"^{name}\s*\?=", block, re.MULTILINE), (
                f"{name} uses ?= on the public profile, so .env / local.env wins"
            )

    def test_public_block_empties_internal_extras(self) -> None:
        block = self._public_block()
        for name in self.INTERNAL_EXTRAS:
            assert re.search(rf"^{name}\s*=\s*$", block, re.MULTILINE), (
                f"{name} is not emptied on the public profile"
            )

    def _resolved(self, profile: str, var: str) -> str:
        """Resolve a variable with internal-profile pins exported, as a stale local.env would."""
        env = dict(os.environ)
        env["DATASET_SEARCH_REGISTRY"] = "ghcr.io/example/internal/cosmos-dataset-search"
        env["DATASET_SEARCH_TAG"] = "internal-0.0.0"
        env["COSMOS_EMBED_IMAGE"] = "ghcr.io/example/internal/cosmos-embed1:internal"
        for name in self.INTERNAL_EXTRAS:
            env[name] = f"ghcr.io/example/internal/{name.lower()}:internal"
        root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
        makefile = f"show-var:\n\t@echo $({var})\n"
        # Run against a copy in an empty directory. The Makefile -includes
        # .env and local.env before the profile defaults, so running in the
        # repository root would resolve the developer's own pins instead of
        # the environment under test.
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            shutil.copy(root / "Makefile", Path(tmp) / "Makefile")
            result = subprocess.run(
                ["make", "-f", "Makefile", "-f", "-", "show-var", f"CDS_PROFILE={profile}"],
                cwd=tmp,
                env=env,
                input=makefile,
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                check=False,
            )
        return result.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1] if result.stdout.strip() else ""

    @pytest.mark.skipif(shutil.which("make") is None, reason="make is not installed")
    def test_internal_pins_cannot_retarget_public(self) -> None:
        for name, value in self.NGC_PINS.items():
            assert self._resolved("public", name) == value, (
                f"{name} on the public profile was retargeted by an internal-profile pin"
            )

    @pytest.mark.skipif(shutil.which("make") is None, reason="make is not installed")
    def test_internal_extras_cannot_reach_a_public_pull(self) -> None:
        for name in self.INTERNAL_EXTRAS:
            assert self._resolved("public", name) == "", (
                f"{name} leaked into the public profile from the environment"
            )

    @pytest.mark.skipif(shutil.which("make") is None, reason="make is not installed")
    def test_internal_profile_can_still_be_repinned(self) -> None:
        """Forcing public must not take pinning away from the internal profile."""
        resolved = self._resolved("internal", "DATASET_SEARCH_TAG")

        assert resolved == "internal-0.0.0", f"internal profile lost its pin: {resolved!r}"

    def _image_check_recipe(self) -> str:
        text = MAKEFILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        start = text.index("check-dataset-search-image:")
        return text[start : text.index("\nup-dataset-search:", start)]

    def test_image_check_asserts_ngc_provenance(self) -> None:
        """Pinning the registry variable cannot catch a poisoned local tag.

        Every profile retags into the same neutral name, so a build from another
        registry pulled as the GA tag would satisfy a plain existence check. RepoDigests
        still names the registry the image was pulled from.
        """
        recipe = self._image_check_recipe()

        assert "{{join .RepoDigests" in recipe
        assert "$(DATASET_SEARCH_REGISTRY)@sha256:" in recipe

    def test_provenance_check_is_scoped_to_public(self) -> None:
        """The internal profile legitimately runs images from other registries."""
        recipe = self._image_check_recipe()
        split = recipe.index("{{join .RepoDigests")

        assert '[ "$(CDS_PROFILE)" = "public" ]' in recipe[:split]
        assert "exit 1" in recipe[split:]

# Minimal Dataset Search stack for integration-layer development.
# Images are PULLED only (make pull-dataset-search) — never built from this repo.
# Milvus/etcd/localstack are upstream dependencies for the Dataset Search API.
# LocalStack is the S3-compatible store Milvus persists to, matching the CDS
# 1.2.0 standalone deployment.
# CDS_API_PUBLIC_URL must be reachable from the operator browser, not a
# container-network hostname.

services:
  etcd:
    image: quay.io/coreos/etcd:v3.5.5
    environment:
      ETCD_AUTO_COMPACTION_MODE: revision
      ETCD_AUTO_COMPACTION_RETENTION: "1000"
      ETCD_QUOTA_BACKEND_BYTES: "4294967296"
    command: etcd -advertise-client-urls=http://etcd:2379 -listen-client-urls http://0.0.0.0:2379 --data-dir /etcd
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "etcdctl", "endpoint", "health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 3

  localstack:
    image: localstack/localstack:4.7
    environment:
      AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: us-east-1
      AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: test
      AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: test
      AWS_ENDPOINT_URL: http://localstack:4566
      BUCKET_NAME: cosmos-test-bucket
    volumes:
      - ./localstack/init:/etc/localstack/init/ready.d:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "awslocal s3 ls >/dev/null 2>&1 || aws --endpoint-url=http://localhost:4566 s3 ls >/dev/null 2>&1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 20

  milvus:
    image: milvusdb/milvus:v2.4.4
    command: ["milvus", "run", "standalone"]
    security_opt:
      - seccomp:unconfined
    environment:
      # Milvus names its object-store settings minio.* whatever the backend
      # is, so these MINIO_ keys configure the LocalStack S3 endpoint. Each
      # name is the config path with the separators removed (minio.accessKeyID
      # becomes MINIO_ACCESSKEYID); this spelling is confirmed to reach Milvus,
      # which logs the resulting endpoint and bucket when it prechecks storage.
      # CDS sets these in a mounted milvus.yaml instead, so their spelling of
      # the env names is not a guide here.
      ETCD_ENDPOINTS: etcd:2379
      MINIO_ADDRESS: localstack:4566
      MINIO_ACCESSKEYID: test
      MINIO_SECRETACCESSKEY: test
      MINIO_BUCKETNAME: cosmos-test-bucket
      MINIO_USESSL: "false"
      MINIO_REGION: us-east-1
    depends_on:
      etcd:
        condition: service_healthy
      localstack:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - "19530:19530"
      - "9091:9091"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:9091/healthz"]
      interval: 30s
      start_period: 90s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 3

  dataset-search:
    image: ${DATASET_SEARCH_IMAGE:-cosmos-dataset-search}:${DATASET_SEARCH_TAG:?Set DATASET_SEARCH_TAG in .env}
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
    environment:
      GUNICORN_PORT: "8888"
      GUNICORN_WORKERS: "1"
      GUNICORN_TIMEOUT: "600"
      MILVUS_DOCUMENT_STORE_URI: http://milvus:19530
      MILVUS_DB: ${MILVUS_DB:-default}
      VISUAL_SEARCH_LOG_LEVEL: INFO
      COSMOS_EMBED_NIM_URI: ${COSMOS_EMBED_NIM_URI:-http://host.docker.internal:9000}
      CRADIO_NIM_URI: ${CRADIO_NIM_URI:-http://host.docker.internal:8001}
      ALLOWED_PIPELINES: ${ALLOWED_PIPELINES:-cosmos_video_search_milvus}
    ports:
      - "8888:8888"
    depends_on:
      milvus:
        condition: service_healthy

# Cosmos-Embed1 query embedder for CDS_PROFILE=public.
# Two contract changes land in CDS 1.2.0 and drive this overlay:
#   1. The backend reads COSMOS_EMBED_URI (1.0.0 read COSMOS_EMBED_NIM_URI).
#      Without it the search pipeline never initialises and every collection
#      call returns HTTP 500 "No pipelines have been initialised".
#   2. Cosmos-Embed1 ships as an OSS container, not a NIM, so it runs as a
#      service here instead of an endpoint the operator starts by hand.
# The image ships COSMOS_EMBED_ALLOW_HF_DOWNLOAD=false, so the mount below is
# the only source of weights.
# Host port stays 9000 so --cosmos-embed-url defaults keep working.
# Used as: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.embed.yml ...

services:
  cosmos-embed:
    image: ${COSMOS_EMBED_IMAGE:?Set COSMOS_EMBED_IMAGE (make pull-dataset-search)}
    environment:
      COSMOS_EMBED_MODEL_PATH: /models/cosmos-embed1
      COSMOS_EMBED_MODEL_VARIANT: ${COSMOS_EMBED_MODEL_VARIANT:-224p}
      NIM_HTTP_API_PORT: "8000"
    volumes:
      - ${COSMOS_EMBED_MODELS_DIR:?Set COSMOS_EMBED_MODELS_DIR to the Cosmos-Embed1 snapshot dir}:/models/cosmos-embed1:ro
    ports:
      - "${COSMOS_EMBED_PORT:-9000}:8000"
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              count: ${COSMOS_EMBED_GPUS:-1}
              capabilities: [gpu]
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - python -c "import urllib.request;urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:8000/v1/health/ready')"
      interval: 15s
      start_period: 300s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 20

  dataset-search:
    environment:
      COSMOS_EMBED_URI: ${COSMOS_EMBED_URI:-http://cosmos-embed:8000}
    depends_on:
      cosmos-embed:
        condition: service_healthy

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# Create the S3 bucket Milvus persists to, mirroring the CDS 1.2.0 standalone
# deployment. LocalStack runs everything in /etc/localstack/init/ready.d once
# it is ready to serve, so Milvus finds the bucket on first start.

set -euo pipefail

BUCKET_NAME="${BUCKET_NAME:-cosmos-test-bucket}"
REGION="${AWS_DEFAULT_REGION:-us-east-1}"
ENDPOINT_URL="${AWS_ENDPOINT_URL:-http://localhost:4566}"

aws_cmd() {
  if command -v awslocal >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    awslocal "$@"
  else
    aws --endpoint-url "${ENDPOINT_URL}" "$@"
  fi
}

if aws_cmd s3api head-bucket --bucket "${BUCKET_NAME}" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "[localstack:init] bucket '${BUCKET_NAME}' already exists"
  exit 0
fi

# us-east-1 rejects an explicit LocationConstraint.
if [ "${REGION}" = "us-east-1" ]; then
  aws_cmd s3api create-bucket --bucket "${BUCKET_NAME}"
else
  aws_cmd s3api create-bucket --bucket "${BUCKET_NAME}" \
    --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint="${REGION}"
fi

echo "[localstack:init] created bucket '${BUCKET_NAME}'"

"""Safety checks for the local/operator Make façade."""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

MAKEFILE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "Makefile"


def _recipe(target: str) -> str:
    text = MAKEFILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    start = text.index(f"{target}:")
    next_target = text.find("\n\n", start)
    return text[start : next_target if next_target >= 0 else len(text)]


def test_integration_make_targets_are_noninteractive() -> None:
    for target in (
        "stage-cds-artifact",
        "ds-bulk-insert",
        "ds-job-status",
        "caption-readiness",
        "caption-search",
        "caption-upload",
        "caption-from-curator",
        "caption-bulk-insert",
        "prepare-cds-ce1-for-tdm",
        "run-image-embeddings",
    ):
        assert "read -p" not in _recipe(target)


def test_caption_from_curator_make_target_uses_curator_output_root() -> None:
    recipe = _recipe("caption-from-curator")
    assert "CURATOR_DIR" in recipe
    assert "integration captions from-curator" in recipe
    assert "CAPTION_JSON" not in recipe
    help_text = MAKEFILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "make caption-from-curator" in help_text


def test_makefile_uses_component_scoped_internal_cli() -> None:
    text = MAKEFILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    assert "CDF_CLI ?= cdf_curation_and_retrieval" in text
    assert "uv run cdf " not in text


def test_object_store_make_targets_pass_credential_names_not_values() -> None:
    recipes = "\n".join(
        [
            _recipe("stage-cds-artifact"),
            _recipe("ds-bulk-insert"),
            _recipe("caption-bulk-insert"),
        ]
    )
    assert "--access-key-env" in recipes
    assert "--secret-key-env" in recipes
    assert "--access-key " not in recipes
    assert "--secret-key " not in recipes


def test_cds_bulk_and_tdm_handoff_require_ce1_declaration() -> None:
    recipes = "\n".join([_recipe("ds-bulk-insert"), _recipe("prepare-cds-ce1-for-tdm")])

    assert recipes.count('--embedding-family "$(CDS_EMBEDDING_FAMILY)"') == 2
    assert recipes.count("ERROR: CDS_EMBEDDING_FAMILY=ce1 required") == 2


def test_cds_make_targets_forward_the_configured_cds_url() -> None:
    """CDS_URL is set in the Makefile and never exported, so recipes must pass it down."""
    cds_targets = (
        "ds-health",
        "ds-collections",
        "ds-get-collection",
        "ds-bulk-insert",
        "ds-job-status",
        "caption-stats",
        "ingest-curator",
    )
    unreachable: list[str] = []
    for target in cds_targets:
        recipe = _recipe(target)
        if '--cds-url "$(CDS_URL)"' not in recipe and 'CDS_URL="$(CDS_URL)"' not in recipe:
            unreachable.append(target)
    assert not unreachable, f"these recipes silently use the default CDS URL: {unreachable}"


def test_ds_get_collection_documents_the_id_only_contract() -> None:
    """CDS resolves this endpoint by id; a name returns 404, so help must not offer one."""
    recipe = _recipe("ds-get-collection")
    text = MAKEFILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    assert "ERROR: COLLECTION= required" in recipe
    assert "collection id" in recipe
    assert "404" in recipe
    assert "name or id" not in recipe
    assert "COLLECTION=<collection-id>" in text


def test_make_owns_public_tao_image_and_passes_it_explicitly() -> None:
    text = MAKEFILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    assert "DATA_MINING_REGISTRY ?= nvcr.io/nvidia/tao/tao-toolkit" in text
    assert "DATA_MINING_TAG ?= 7.2.0-data-services" in text
    assert "DATA_MINING_IMAGE ?= tao-toolkit" in text
    assert "TDM_EMBEDDING_BACKEND ?= ce1" in text
    for target in (

# Cosmos Data Factory Curation and Retrieval Documentation

Turn raw video and image collections into training-ready datasets for
physical AI. Curation and Retrieval runs three GPU-accelerated NVIDIA engines
behind one Make interface:

- **Cosmos Curator** splits, captions, filters, and shards video and images.
- **Data Mining** generates embeddings and selects data by nearest neighbor.
- **Cosmos Dataset Search** indexes curated clips and finds them by text query.

![Curation and Retrieval architecture](assets/CDF-CC-CDS-TDM.png)

## Quick Start

def _json_response(payload, status_code: int = 200) -> MagicMock:
    response = MagicMock()
    response.status_code = status_code
    response.content = b"{}" if payload is not None else b""
    response.text = "{}" if isinstance(payload, dict) else ""
    response.headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
    response.json.return_value = payload
    if status_code >= 400:
        http_error = requests.HTTPError(response=response)
        response.raise_for_status.side_effect = http_error
    else:
        response.raise_for_status = MagicMock()
    return response

## Requirements

Install only what the chosen path needs.

| Item | Minimum |
|------|---------|
| OS | Ubuntu 22.04 or 24.04 LTS (Linux) |
| Docker | 20.10+ |
| NVIDIA Container Toolkit | Installed and working with Docker |
| GPU | NVIDIA data-center GPU (A40 / A100 / H100 class recommended) |
| CPU | 16+ cores |
| RAM | 64GB system RAM |
| Storage | 500GB SSD; add ~90GB for Curator models |
| Python | `>=3.10,<3.13` using [`uv`](https://github.com/astral.sh/uv); 3.12 recommended |
| Make | GNU Make |

| Path | Extra requirements |
|------|-------------------|
| Path B Data Mining | One GPU is enough for smoke runs; no Curator weights or FFmpeg |
| Path A Curator | FFmpeg sidecar (`make ffmpeg-install`); `MODELS_DIR` (~90GB+) |
| Full Curator video recipes | 48GB+ VRAM; vision-language model (VLM) and large language model (LLM) endpoints for caption cookbooks |
| Path D Cosmos Dataset Search (CDS) | x86_64 (amd64) host; CDS has no ARM64 build. Refer to [Limitations](#limitations) |
| Sample clips | NGC CLI 4.10.0+ and an API key. Refer to [Samples and Cookbooks](samples-and-cookbooks.md) |

TAO Toolkit Data Services documents driver `595.45.04` as a floor. Qualify the
selected Curator image independently.

Never put credentials on Make command lines, in cookbook YAML, or in logs.

## Clone and Sync

```bash
git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/cdf-curation-and-retrieval.git
cd cdf-curation-and-retrieval
cp .env.example .env
uv sync --extra dev
docker login nvcr.io
```

Install `uv` from the
[standalone installer](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/).
The Ubuntu snap build is not supported: a snap-confined `uv` cannot create
the project virtual environment. `command -v uv` must not point at
`/snap/bin/uv`.

This repository **pulls** published vendor images. It does not build or push
vendor images as part of the supported path.

### Cosmos Curator Path A

`make setup` runs `make pull`, `make ffmpeg-install`, and `make check-setup`.

```bash
make setup
make download-models MODELS_DIR=/path/to/models
```

The default FFmpeg sidecar path is `$HOME/cosmos-curator-ffmpeg`.

Model tokens and optional SeedVR2 / Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) notes:
[Cosmos Curator](operations-curator.md).

**Success signals**

- `make check-setup` validates Docker, GPU visibility, and the FFmpeg sidecar
- Models directory populated under `MODELS_DIR`

### Data Mining Path B

```bash
make pull-data-mining
make check-data-mining-image
```

**Success signals**

- `docker pull` completes without auth errors
- `make check-data-mining-image` exits 0

### Cosmos Dataset Search Path D

```bash
make pull-dataset-search \
  CDS_PROFILE=public \
  DATASET_SEARCH_REGISTRY=nvcr.io/nvidia/blueprint/cosmos-dataset-search \
  DATASET_SEARCH_TAG=1.2.0
make check-dataset-search-image \
  DATASET_SEARCH_TAG=1.2.0
```

If `.env` or gitignored `local.env` sets `CDS_PROFILE` to a value other than
`public`, you **must** pass the Make arguments above for public generally
available (GA). On the default public profile, image pins in those files are
ignored. Refer to
[Cosmos Dataset Search](operations-cds.md).

**Expected success signals**

- Local image `cosmos-dataset-search:1.2.0` exists
- After `make up-dataset-search` with the matching profile, `make ds-health`
  prints `{"status": "OK"}` (retry until gunicorn is up)
- `curl -sS http://localhost:8888/v1/pipelines` shows
  `cosmos_video_search_milvus` with `"enabled": true`

### Pull All Published Images

```bash
make pull-all
```

`pull-all` pulls Curator, Dataset Search, and Data Mining images. Starting
Compose, waiting for health, ingest, and search:
[Cosmos Dataset Search](operations-cds.md).

### Verify GPU Visibility

```bash
docker run --rm --gpus all nvidia/cuda:12.0.0-base-ubuntu22.04 nvidia-smi
```

If installation fails, refer to [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md).

| Cosmos-Embed1 (CE1 OSS) | `COSMOS_EMBED_IMAGE` | `nvcr.io/nvidia/blueprint/cosmos-embed1-oss:1.2.0` |
| Data Mining | `DATA_MINING_REGISTRY`, `DATA_MINING_TAG` | `nvcr.io/nvidia/tao/tao-toolkit:7.2.0-data-services` |

Product version `1.2.0` (`pyproject.toml`) describes this repository.
Container tags are separate pins.

### Cosmos-Embed1 Weights

From CDS `1.2.0` the query embedder runs as a container that `make
up-dataset-search` starts for you, and the image cannot download its own
weights (`COSMOS_EMBED_ALLOW_HF_DOWNLOAD=false`). Point
`COSMOS_EMBED_MODELS_DIR` at a local snapshot:

```bash
hf download nvidia/Cosmos-Embed1-224p \
  --revision 787e0b996f5260a71ad474a283c90539a2e12986 \
  --local-dir /path/to/Cosmos-Embed1-224p
```

Specify the revision. CE1 OSS `1.2.0` verifies the snapshot against a
checksum manifest that ships inside the image and refuses to serve any other
revision. A mismatched snapshot leaves the container unhealthy and reports
`CE1 snapshot checksum mismatch`. Re-download the weights at the pinned
revision whenever the CDS version changes.

## Credentials

| Need | When |
|------|------|
| NGC / `nvcr.io` Docker login | Pulling Curator and TAO images |
| NGC CLI API key | Downloading Video Search and Summarization (VSS) sample clips |
| Hugging Face token | Gated Curator weights (for example SAM3) |
| OpenAI-compatible VLM and LLM keys | Caption cookbooks. Refer to [VLM and LLM Endpoints](vlm-llm-endpoints.md) |

Keep secrets in the environment or gitignored `.env` / `local.env`. Do not
put API keys on Make argv.

Hugging Face token file (Curator):

```bash
mkdir -p ~/.config/cosmos_curator
chmod 600 ~/.config/cosmos_curator/hf_token.txt
```

## Limitations

- Cosmos Dataset Search Path D is local Compose only. Refer to
  [Cosmos Dataset Search](operations-cds.md).
- **CDS does not run on ARM.** The CDS API and Cosmos-Embed1 images are
  published as single-arch `linux/amd64`, so an ARM64/aarch64 host
  (Grace, Thor, Jetson) cannot run Path D no matter which NVIDIA GPU is
  attached. Milvus and TAO Toolkit do ship `arm64` variants; CDS does not,
  and no emulation path is supported.
- **CDS does not support Blackwell (B-series) GPUs.** The published
  Cosmos-Embed1 container has no kernels for compute capability 10.0
  (`sm_100`: B100, B200, GB200) or 12.0 (`sm_120`: RTX PRO 6000
  Blackwell); the CDS API does not use the GPU.
  The "Other Ampere+ GPUs" entry in the
  upstream CDS prerequisites excludes Blackwell. Qualify Path D on Hopper
  (H100, H20), Ada (L40S, L4, L20), or Ampere (A100, A40) class GPUs with
  16GB+ VRAM; 24GB+ is recommended. This limit applies to CDS only.
  Cosmos Curator and TAO are separate images that do run on Blackwell, so
  Paths A, B, and C are unaffected.
- Building or pushing vendor images is not supported; pull only.
- There is no in-repo scheduler. Sequence Make targets yourself.
- Make is the public interface; the helper CLI is an implementation detail.
- TAO mining does not generate embeddings. Run Curator or TAO `embedding` first.
- Metric `l2` is not accepted; use `euclidean`.
- `coco` detections must be a single JSON file; `kitti` must be a label
  directory.
- The repository does not publish a performance SLA. Time a short clip or a few
  parquet rows on your host before you scale.

Optional Curator source builds (`make clone-curator` / `make build`) are
developer-only. Refer to [Developer Docs](../developer/README.md).

Some Curator cookbooks caption, filter, classify, or enhance text through
OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoints (vLLM, NIM, or a hosted API). Other runs
use in-process models inside the Curator container and do not need these
services.

Model files under `MODELS_DIR` are not enough for endpoint-backed runs. You
must have live HTTP services reachable from the Curator container.

## When You Need Endpoints

| Path | Endpoints required? |
|------|---------------------|
| Local in-process Curator | No |
| Full-split cookbooks with remote captioning | Yes: caption, filter, and classifier vision-language model (VLM), and enhance large language model (LLM) |
| Embeddings or mining only (Path B) | No |

Cosmos Curator does **not** take endpoint URLs from cookbook YAML. Make builds
`/cosmos_curator/config/cosmos_curator.yaml` from environment variables using
`adapters.cosmos_curator.openai_config_env` before each Curator Docker run.

## Roles and Environment Variables

| Role | Curator stage | Base URL env | API key env |
|------|---------------|--------------|-------------|
| `caption` | Window / event caption VLM | `COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_CAPTION_BASE_URL` | `COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_CAPTION_API_KEY` |
| `filter` | VLM filter | `COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_FILTER_BASE_URL` | `COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_FILTER_API_KEY` |
| `classifier` | Video classifier | `COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_CLASSIFIER_BASE_URL` | `COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_CLASSIFIER_API_KEY` |
| `enhance` | Caption enhance LLM | `COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_ENHANCE_BASE_URL` | `COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_ENHANCE_API_KEY` |
| `embedding` | Optional remote embed API | `COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_BASE_URL` | `COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_API_KEY` |

Notes:

- Put values in gitignored `local.env` or export them in the shell. Never commit
  keys. Refer to [Installation](installation.md).
- If unset, filter and classifier default to the caption VLM URL.
- Missing API keys default to `EMPTY` (typical for local open endpoints).
- Template comments: `.env.example`.

You set the environment variables above (or in gitignored `local.env`) and run
`make run-pipeline`. Make generates the Curator OpenAI config mount
automatically.

## Scenario A Local Endpoint Containers

Use when you host vLLM (or equivalent) on the same machine. Keep endpoint GPUs
**separate** from Curator and TAO GPUs.

### Example Four-GPU Map

| Host GPU | Owner | Use |
|----------|-------|-----|
| 0 | VLM | Caption, filter, classifier |
| 1 | LLM | Text enhancement |
| 2 | Curator | Split, Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3), InternVideo2 (IV2), orchestration |
| 3 | TAO | Image and text embeddings, nearest neighbors, unique neighbor matching |

Confirm free memory before launch:

```bash
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,memory.used,memory.free --format=csv
```

### Launch a Local VLM

Requires: NGC login for the vLLM image, models present under `MODELS_DIR`
(for example after `make download-models`), and an approved `HF_TOKEN` when
gated weights need it.

```bash
# Adjust MODELS_DIR and GPU indices for your host.
export MODELS_DIR=${MODELS_DIR:-$HOME/models}

docker rm -f cdf-vlm cdf-llm 2>/dev/null || true

docker run -d --name cdf-vlm --gpus '"device=0"' --ipc=host \
  -p 8000:8000 \
  -e HF_TOKEN="$HF_TOKEN" \
  -v "$MODELS_DIR:/models:ro" \
  nvcr.io/nvidia/vllm:26.04-py3 \
  vllm serve /models/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-FP8 \
    --served-model-name Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-FP8 \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 \
    --tensor-parallel-size 1 \
    --max-model-len 32768 \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 \
    --max-num-seqs 1 \
    --enforce-eager

docker run -d --name cdf-llm --gpus '"device=1"' --ipc=host \
  -p 8002:8002 \
  -e HF_TOKEN="$HF_TOKEN" \
  -v "$MODELS_DIR:/models:ro" \
  nvcr.io/nvidia/vllm:26.04-py3 \
  vllm serve /models/Qwen/Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct \
    --served-model-name Qwen/Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct \
    --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8002 --max-model-len 16384
```

Keep `--max-num-seqs 1` on the VLM so long video caption requests stay
serialized. Endpoint-backed runs are expected to be slower with this setting.

### Health Check on the Host

```bash
curl --fail --silent --show-error "http://localhost:8000/v1/models"
curl --fail --silent --show-error "http://localhost:8002/v1/models"
```

### Point Curator at the Endpoints

With Make's default Docker **bridge** network, use `host.docker.internal` and
pass the Linux host-gateway mapping:

```bash
export COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_CAPTION_BASE_URL="http://host.docker.internal:8000/v1"
export COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_FILTER_BASE_URL="$COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_CAPTION_BASE_URL"
export COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_CLASSIFIER_BASE_URL="$COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_CAPTION_BASE_URL"
export COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_ENHANCE_BASE_URL="http://host.docker.internal:8002/v1"
export COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_CAPTION_API_KEY="EMPTY"
export COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_FILTER_API_KEY="EMPTY"
export COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_CLASSIFIER_API_KEY="EMPTY"
export COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_ENHANCE_API_KEY="EMPTY"

export EXTRA_DOCKER_ARGS="--add-host host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
export GPUS='"device=2"'   # Curator pool; do not use GPUS=all while endpoints own 0/1
```

Confirm the host health check above succeeds, then run Make:

```bash
make run-pipeline \
  CONFIG_FILE=cookbook/traffic-video-analytics/split.yaml \
  MODELS_DIR="$MODELS_DIR" \
  DATA_DIR=/path/to/data \
  FFMPEG_DIR=$HOME/cosmos-curator-ffmpeg \
  GPUS='"device=2"' \
  EXTRA_DOCKER_ARGS="--add-host host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
```

If Curator still cannot reach the endpoints, confirm `EXTRA_DOCKER_ARGS` includes
the host-gateway mapping. Refer to [Failure Modes](#failure-modes).

### Tear Down

```bash
docker rm -f cdf-vlm cdf-llm
```

When a platform team provides OpenAI-compatible URLs and model names:

```bash
export COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_CAPTION_BASE_URL="<provided-vlm-endpoint>/v1"
export COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_FILTER_BASE_URL="$COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_CAPTION_BASE_URL"
export COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_CLASSIFIER_BASE_URL="$COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_CAPTION_BASE_URL"
export COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_ENHANCE_BASE_URL="<provided-llm-endpoint>/v1"
export COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_CAPTION_API_KEY="[REDACTED]"
export COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_FILTER_API_KEY="[REDACTED]"
export COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_CLASSIFIER_API_KEY="[REDACTED]"
export COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_ENHANCE_API_KEY="[REDACTED]"
```

```bash
curl --fail --silent --show-error \
  --oauth2-bearer "$COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_CAPTION_API_KEY" \
  "$COSMOS_CURATOR_OPENAI_CAPTION_BASE_URL/models" >/dev/null
```

`EXTRA_DOCKER_ARGS` is needed only if the URL uses `host.docker.internal`.

## GPU Quoting

Preserve Docker's quoted device expression:

```bash
export GPUS='"device=2"'
# Wrong: GPUS=device=2   (Docker rejects this form)
```

While local VLM and LLM containers occupy GPUs, do not set `GPUS=all` for Curator
or TAO.

## Failure Modes

| Symptom | Likely cause | Action |
|---------|--------------|--------|
| Curator cannot reach endpoint | Missing host-gateway / wrong URL | Set `EXTRA_DOCKER_ARGS`; check host `/v1/models` again |
| `/v1/models` fails on host | Endpoint not ready or wrong port | `docker logs cdf-vlm` / `cdf-llm`; wait for ready |
| VLM HTTP 500, `EngineDeadError`, deepstack token errors | Endpoint overload / bad profile | Relaunch VLM with the stable flags above (`--max-num-seqs 1`) |
| Job appears hung | Serialized VLM queue | Check VLM logs for queue progress before killing |
| Auth errors on hosted API | Bad or missing key | Fix key in `local.env`; do not put it on Make argv |

# Cosmos Dataset Search

Task-oriented reference for public GA CDS bring-up and CE1 ingest/search.
Make is the local operator façade; agents and orchestrators should invoke the equivalent
installed `cdf_curation_and_retrieval` CLI.

In Curation and Retrieval 1.2, the adapter, CLI, Make targets, and handoff
docs provide invocation coverage for the GA CDS core. This is not a
substitute for live CDS deployment acceptance.

## Hardware constraint

CDS does not run on Blackwell (B-series) GPUs. The published Cosmos-Embed1
container has no kernels for compute capability 10.0 (`sm_100`: B100, B200,
GB200) or 12.0 (`sm_120`: RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell); the CDS API does not use
the GPU. Select a Hopper, Ada, or
Ampere class GPU with 16GB+ VRAM for Path D. Curator and TAO are
unaffected.

## Select the image

`CDS_PROFILE=public` uses the public GA pin
`nvcr.io/nvidia/blueprint/cosmos-dataset-search:1.2.0`.

Make loads the committed example environment file first, then the
gitignored operator overlay (the overlay wins). The default
`CDS_PROFILE=public` then assigns the GA pins, so image pins in those files
apply only when one of them sets another `CDS_PROFILE`. Shell prefixes such as
`CDS_PROFILE=public make ...` do **not** override a profile set there. Pass
Make arguments: `make pull-dataset-search CDS_PROFILE=public
DATASET_SEARCH_TAG=1.2.0 DATASET_SEARCH_REGISTRY=nvcr.io/nvidia/blueprint/cosmos-dataset-search`.

Operator Path D (compose, wait for health, collection **id**, lab ingest):
`docs/user-guide/operations-cds.md` and repository `README.md` Path D.
CDS deployed elsewhere (cluster, shared lab host): this repository does not
deploy CDS outside compose. Clone CDS from
`https://github.com/NVIDIA-Omniverse-blueprints/cosmos-dataset-search.git`
and deploy it by whichever route that repository documents for the target. CDS documents AWS EKS; it
claims generic-Kubernetes charts but ships no guide for them, so do not
promise a generic-cluster recipe. Then treat CDS as a prerequisite endpoint:
`export CDS_URL=<that API>` and run `make ds-health` before any other Path D
target. On Kubernetes that URL ends in `/api`, because CDS sets
`FASTAPI_ROOT_PATH=/api` and its ingress routes `/api/` without rewriting;
compose has no prefix. Never offer a Helm install from this repo.
Public GA uses `CDS_PROFILE=public` and image `1.2.0`. Do not
skip `make up-dataset-search` on a laptop. Do not call `ds-health` until
`curl -sf http://localhost:8888/health` succeeds.

```bash
# Public GA — Make arguments beat the gitignored operator overlay
make pull-dataset-search \
  CDS_PROFILE=public \
  DATASET_SEARCH_REGISTRY=nvcr.io/nvidia/blueprint/cosmos-dataset-search \
  DATASET_SEARCH_TAG=1.2.0
make up-dataset-search \
  CDS_PROFILE=public \
  DATASET_SEARCH_REGISTRY=nvcr.io/nvidia/blueprint/cosmos-dataset-search \
  DATASET_SEARCH_TAG=1.2.0

```

Search needs a Cosmos-Embed1 service on host port 9000 to embed the text
query. `CDS_PROFILE=public` starts it: `up-dataset-search` adds the embed
overlay and the API reaches it via `COSMOS_EMBED_URI`.
The image cannot download its own weights: set `COSMOS_EMBED_MODELS_DIR`
to a snapshot of `nvidia/Cosmos-Embed1-224p` at revision
`787e0b996f5260a71ad474a283c90539a2e12986`. Any other revision fails the
container's checksum check.

## Verify core CDS operations

Public GA pipeline id is `cosmos_video_search_milvus`. Confirm
`"enabled": true` with `curl -sS http://localhost:8888/v1/pipelines`
(`make ds-pipelines` lists names only).
Create-collection returns an **id**; ingest and search must use that id,
not `NAME=traffic`.

```bash
make ds-health
make ds-pipelines
make ds-collections
make ds-create-collection \
  NAME=traffic \
  PIPELINE=cosmos_video_search_milvus
make ds-get-collection COLLECTION=<id-from-create>
make search COLLECTION=<id-from-create> QUERY='pedestrian crossing the road'
```

## CE1 artifact policy

CDS-bound Curator ingest accepts CE1 only:

- Use `EMBEDDING_BACKEND=ce1`, or `auto` only when CDS-bound ingest selects CE1.
- Declare `CDS_EMBEDDING_FAMILY=ce1` for bulk insert.
- Curator IV2 remains valid for TMM, not CDS ingest.
- Vectors do not identify their producer; the family declaration is mandatory.

## Public GA bulk-ingest workflow

Follow this order:

1. Confirm CDS is healthy.
2. Convert and validate a Curator CE1 export.
3. Stage the validated parquet in CDS-readable object storage.
4. Create the collection and keep the returned **id**.
5. Submit one non-retried `/insert-data` request.
6. Poll the returned job to a successful terminal state.
7. Search only after successful completion.

Use pipeline `cosmos_video_search_milvus` on public 1.2.0.

```bash
make ds-health

make ingest-curator \
  CURATOR_DIR=/path/to/curator/ce1-output \
  OUT=$PWD/data/cds-ce1.parquet \
  EMBEDDING_BACKEND=ce1

make stage-cds-artifact \
  STAGE_SOURCE=$PWD/data/cds-ce1.parquet \
  STAGE_DESTINATION=s3://bucket/cds-ce1.parquet \
  OBJECT_STORE_ENDPOINT=https://objects.example

make ds-create-collection \
  NAME=traffic \
  PIPELINE=cosmos_video_search_milvus

make ds-bulk-insert \
  COLLECTION=<id-from-create> \
  PARQUET_URI=s3://bucket/cds-ce1.parquet \
  CDS_EMBEDDING_FAMILY=ce1

make ds-job-status JOB_ID=<job-id> WAIT=1
make search COLLECTION=<id-from-create> QUERY='pedestrian crossing the road'
```

`ingest-curator` in convert-only mode validates the export while creating the
CDS-shaped parquet. Capture `job_id` from the bulk-insert JSON result. A waited
job that times out or reaches failed/cancelled/error exits nonzero.

### Fail closed on `/insert-data` 404

HTTP 404 from `POST /insert-data` fails closed by default. On local compose
the body is often `Collection not found` (name used as id) or `File not
found` (host path). That is not a missing route.

Lab document ingest (`ALLOW_LAB_DOCUMENT_FALLBACK=1`) with the collection
**id** is the Path D smoke path in `docs/user-guide/operations-cds.md`.
A fallback result is never evidence of GA bulk-ingest success. Agents
must not present lab ingest as GA `/insert-data` qualification.

## Secure object-store staging

- Use an absolute HTTPS endpoint by default.
- Permit HTTP only in an isolated lab with
  `ALLOW_LAB_HTTP_ENDPOINT=1`.
- Pass credential environment-variable **names** through
  `OBJECT_STORE_ACCESS_KEY_ENV` and `OBJECT_STORE_SECRET_KEY_ENV`.
- Never put credential values in command arguments, docs, or logs.
- Both referenced variables must be set together. Staging failures redact
  worker output.

Example using operator-owned environment names:

```bash
make stage-cds-artifact \
  STAGE_SOURCE=$PWD/data/cds-ce1.parquet \
  STAGE_DESTINATION=s3://bucket/cds-ce1.parquet \
  OBJECT_STORE_ENDPOINT=https://objects.example \
  OBJECT_STORE_ACCESS_KEY_ENV=CDF_S3_ACCESS_KEY \
  OBJECT_STORE_SECRET_KEY_ENV=CDF_S3_SECRET_KEY
```

## Machine-readable automation

Prefer the installed `cdf_curation_and_retrieval` CLI for automation; Make
may add operator-oriented output.

- CDS and integration success payloads are JSON.
- `ingest-curator --ingest` emits one JSON object per completed phase.
- Waited job failures emit JSON before exiting nonzero.
- Click usage/parsing and direct `ClickException` paths may emit
  human-readable stderr.

Treat every nonzero exit as failure. Do not infer success from partial output,
and never retry POST submissions automatically.

This page is the operator recipe for **Path D**: take Cosmos-Embed1 (CE1)
clips from Cosmos Curator, start Cosmos Dataset Search (CDS) on this host,
ingest those clips, and search with a text query. The supported path is
public generally available (GA) 1.2.0.

You do not need prior CDS, Docker Compose, or Milvus experience. Run the
commands from the repository root. The public interface is Make. Do not invent
extra CLI flags.

The repository README lists Path A through Path D. This page is the Path D
recipe. Use Choose a Path, then copy each block as written unless a comment
tells you to substitute a value.

## Choose a Path

| Goal | Section |
|------|---------|
| Public generally available (GA) 1.2.0 on this host | [Public GA Recipe](#public-ga-recipe) |
| CDS already deployed | [Using a CDS You Deployed Yourself](#using-a-cds-you-deployed-yourself) |

## What CDS Includes

CDS is a search API. It stores clip embeddings and returns the closest
clips for a text query.

This repository:

- **Does** pull a published CDS container image (GA).
- **Does** start a small local stack with Docker Compose: etcd, LocalStack,
  Milvus, and the CDS API on port **8888**.
- **Does** work against a CDS API you deployed yourself, anywhere. Set
  `CDS_URL` and every step below behaves the same.
- **Does not** build the CDS image or deploy CDS on Kubernetes. Cluster
  bring-up belongs to the CDS repository.
- **Does not** run on ARM. The CDS API and Cosmos-Embed1 images are
  published for `linux/amd64` only, so an ARM64/aarch64 host cannot start
  the stack even with a supported NVIDIA GPU. Use an x86_64 host.
- **Does not** support Blackwell (B-series) GPUs. The Cosmos-Embed1
  1.2.0 image has no kernels for compute capability 10.0
  (`sm_100`: B100, B200, GB200) or 12.0 (`sm_120`: RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell);
  the CDS API itself does not use the GPU. Use a Hopper (H100, H20), Ada
  (L40S, L4, L20), or Ampere (A100, A40) class GPU with 16GB+ VRAM.
- **Does** start Cosmos-Embed1 for text search on host port **9000**.
  Ingest of **already computed** CE1 vectors does not need it. Refer to
  [Verify Cosmos-Embed1](#verify-cosmos-embed1).
- **Does not** accept InternVideo2 (IV2) embeddings. Warehouse
  `split-minimal.yaml` uses IV2 for Path C / TMM, not Path D.

## Ingest Modes

| Mode | When | What you pass |
|------|------|----------------|
| **Lab document ingest** | Local compose; parquet on disk | Collection **id** and `ALLOW_LAB_DOCUMENT_FALLBACK=1` |
| **GA bulk ingest** | CDS can read `s3://` parquet | Collection **id** and `PARQUET_URI=s3://...` |

Local compose accepts `POST /v1/insert-data` but cannot read a parquet
file on the host filesystem. Such a request returns HTTP 400
(`Parquet imports require plain s3://bucket/key paths`), after which the
adapter falls back to document ingest. No operator action is required.

Use lab document ingest as the Path D smoke test on compose. It does
**not** validate GA bulk ingest, which requires parquet in object
storage.

## Using a CDS You Deployed Yourself

Compose is the laptop Path D stack. On a cluster or a shared host, CDS is a **prerequisite endpoint**: deploy it from
its own repository, then point this repo at it. This repository does not
deploy CDS on Kubernetes and does not wrap CDS `k8s_up.sh` (AWS EKS).

```bash
git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA-Omniverse-blueprints/cosmos-dataset-search.git
cd cosmos-dataset-search
# Deploy by whichever route that repository documents for your target.
# CDS documents AWS EKS; refer to its README for current options.

# Kubernetes: CDS sets FASTAPI_ROOT_PATH=/api and its ingress routes /api/,
# so the base URL carries that prefix. Compose has no prefix
# (http://localhost:8888).
export CDS_URL=https://cds.example.com/api
make ds-health
```

`CDS_URL` is the API root without `/v1`; the client appends it. `/health` is
served at the service root rather than under `/v1`, so with the prefix above
the precheck resolves to `https://cds.example.com/api/health`.

If CDS's own bring-up generated its self-signed TLS certificate, point
`REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE` at that certificate before running `ds-health`, or the
call fails certificate verification rather than reporting on CDS.

`make ds-health` is the precheck: run it before any collection, ingest,
or search target. Every one of those targets accepts `--cds-url`
and honors `CDS_URL`, so nothing else changes. If health fails, fix the
endpoint before continuing; the later steps will only fail less clearly.

After health, continue from collection create using the collection **id**.

## Before You Start

Complete **Path A** with Cosmos-Embed1. Traffic first-run:

```bash
make run-pipeline \
  CONFIG_FILE=cookbook/traffic-video-analytics/split-minimal.yaml \
  DATA_DIR=$PWD/cookbook/traffic-video-analytics \
  MODELS_DIR=/path/to/models \
  FFMPEG_DIR=$HOME/cosmos-curator-ffmpeg
```

Replace `/path/to/models` with the host directory that contains
`nvidia/Cosmos-Embed1-224p`.

**Success for Path A:** this directory exists and contains `.parquet`
files:

`cookbook/traffic-video-analytics/output/split-minimal/ce1_embd_224p_parquet/`

Also required:

- Docker 20.10+ and permission to run `docker` without sudo (or use sudo
  consistently).
- `docker login nvcr.io` already succeeded (same as Curator pull).
- `uv sync --extra dev` already succeeded.
- Port **8888** free on the host (CDS API). Ports **19530** and **9091**
  free (Milvus).

### Do Not Reuse an InternVideo2 Output Directory

If `output/split-minimal/` already has `iv2_embd_parquet/` from an older
run, Curator might skip videos and never write CE1 for them. For a clean
CE1 run, delete that output directory or change `output_clip_path` in the
YAML (for example `/data/output/split-minimal-ce1`). Confirm
`summary.json` contains `"embedding_algorithm": "cosmos-embed1-224p"`.

### Environment File Precedence

The Makefile loads `.env`, then **`local.env`**. `local.env` wins.

The default profile, `CDS_PROFILE=public`, always uses the public `1.2.0`
image. It ignores any `DATASET_SEARCH_REGISTRY` or `DATASET_SEARCH_TAG` in
those files.

Image pins in those files take effect only when one of them sets
`CDS_PROFILE` to a value other than `public`. Bare `make pull-dataset-search`
and `make up-dataset-search` then use those pins, not public `1.2.0`.
A shell prefix does **not** override a value set in an environment file:

```bash
# Does NOT beat CDS_PROFILE set in local.env
CDS_PROFILE=public make pull-dataset-search
```

Pass `CDS_PROFILE=public` as a Make argument on the `make` command itself
(refer to [Public GA Recipe](#public-ga-recipe)).

## Public GA Recipe

### Pull the Public CDS Image

From the repository root:

```bash
docker login nvcr.io
make pull-dataset-search \
  CDS_PROFILE=public \
  DATASET_SEARCH_REGISTRY=nvcr.io/nvidia/blueprint/cosmos-dataset-search \
  DATASET_SEARCH_TAG=1.2.0
```

**Success:** the command prints `Pull complete: cosmos-dataset-search:1.2.0`.

If it prints `DATASET_SEARCH_REGISTRY and DATASET_SEARCH_TAG are not
set`, or a tag other than `1.2.0`, `.env` or `local.env` sets `CDS_PROFILE`
to another profile. Re-run with the Make arguments above.

### Stop Leftover Compose Containers

An old Milvus container with a newly created etcd will exit with code 1
(`disconnected from etcd`). Tear the stack down first:

```bash
make down-dataset-search
docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml down --remove-orphans
```

If `compose-milvus-1` is still listed in `docker ps -a`, remove it:

```bash
docker rm -f compose-milvus-1
```

### Start CDS

```bash
make up-dataset-search \
  CDS_PROFILE=public \
  DATASET_SEARCH_REGISTRY=nvcr.io/nvidia/blueprint/cosmos-dataset-search \
  DATASET_SEARCH_TAG=1.2.0 \
  COSMOS_EMBED_MODELS_DIR=/path/to/Cosmos-Embed1-224p
```

The public profile adds `deploy/compose/docker-compose.embed.yml`, which
runs Cosmos-Embed1 as a service and sets `COSMOS_EMBED_URI` for the API.
Point `COSMOS_EMBED_MODELS_DIR` at a snapshot of the pinned revision. Refer to
[Cosmos-Embed1 Weights](installation.md#cosmos-embed1-weights).

If the overlay is omitted, the API reports healthy but the first
collection call returns HTTP 500 (`No pipelines have been initialised`).

**Success:** Compose shows etcd, LocalStack, Milvus, and `cosmos-embed`
**Healthy**, and `compose-dataset-search-1` **Started** or **Healthy**. The
image column must be `cosmos-dataset-search:1.2.0`.

```bash
docker ps --filter name=compose- --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}} {{.Status}}'
```

Compose returns as soon as the CDS container **starts**. Gunicorn might
still be booting. Do not run `make ds-health` in the same paste as `up`.

### Wait Until the API Answers

Retry until health is OK (often 30–90 seconds):

```bash
until curl -sf http://localhost:8888/health; do
  echo "CDS still starting; retry in 10 seconds"
  sleep 10
done
make ds-health
```

**Success:** `make ds-health` prints `{"status": "OK"}`.

If the wait loop prints `Connection reset by peer`, wait and retry. That error means
the port is open but the process is not serving yet.

### Confirm the Video Pipeline Is Enabled

```bash
make ds-pipelines
curl -sS http://localhost:8888/v1/pipelines
```

`make ds-pipelines` lists pipeline **names** only. It does **not** show
whether a pipeline loaded. The `curl` JSON must contain
`"id": "cosmos_video_search_milvus"` and `"enabled": true`.

If `"enabled": false`, read the `"missing"` list. On the public `1.2.0`
image those fields are empty and the pipeline is enabled. If the image
is not `1.2.0`, switch to public `1.2.0` (pull, stop leftover containers,
and start CDS).

### Create a Collection and Copy the Id

CDS looks up collections by **id**, not by the human name `traffic`.
`GET /v1/collections/traffic` returns 404.

```bash
make ds-create-collection \
  NAME=traffic \
  PIPELINE=cosmos_video_search_milvus
```

**Success:** JSON includes both a name and an id, for example:

```json
{
  "id": "a4892af7c_eadb_4e21_a833_9273d21e0d86",
  "name": "traffic",
  "pipeline": "cosmos_video_search_milvus",
  "tags": {}
}
```

Copy the `id` string. In the rest of this page it is
`TRAFFIC_COLLECTION_ID`. Your id will differ. Do not paste the
placeholder `TRAFFIC_COLLECTION_ID` into Make; that 404s the same as
using the collection name.

Confirm:

```bash
make ds-get-collection COLLECTION=TRAFFIC_COLLECTION_ID
```

Substitute your id. This must return HTTP 200. Using `COLLECTION=traffic`
here fails.

### Convert CE1 and Ingest

`CURATOR_DIR` is the Curator **output root**, not the parquet folder.

| Wrong | Right |
|-------|--------|
| `.../output/split-minimal/ce1_embd_224p_parquet` | `.../output/split-minimal` |

The ingest step searches **under** `CURATOR_DIR` for `ce1_embd_*_parquet/`.

```bash
make ingest-curator \
  CURATOR_DIR=$PWD/cookbook/traffic-video-analytics/output/split-minimal \
  OUT=$PWD/cookbook/traffic-video-analytics/output/cds-traffic.parquet \
  EMBEDDING_BACKEND=ce1 \
  COLLECTION=TRAFFIC_COLLECTION_ID \
  ALLOW_LAB_DOCUMENT_FALLBACK=1
```

Substitute `TRAFFIC_COLLECTION_ID`. Keep
`ALLOW_LAB_DOCUMENT_FALLBACK=1` on local compose.

**Success:** two JSON objects. The second looks like:

```json
{
  "ingested": true,
  "collection": "TRAFFIC_COLLECTION_ID",
  "job_id": "documents:13",
  "embedding_family": "ce1"
}
```

`documents:13` means 13 clip vectors were posted. Your count depends on
how many CE1 clips Curator wrote.

If `CURATOR_DIR` points at the parquet directory itself, ingest exits
with `No ce1_embd_parquet/ or ce1_embd_*_parquet/`. Point at the parent.

If `COLLECTION=traffic` (the name), fallback posts to
`/v1/collections/traffic/documents` and CDS returns 404. Use the id.

Collection metadata might still show `"total_documents_count": 0`. Search is the check that vectors are queryable.

### Verify Cosmos-Embed1

Cosmos-Embed1 embeds the **text query**. `make up-dataset-search` starts
it when you start CDS, and the API reaches it at `COSMOS_EMBED_URI`. It listens on
host port **9000**.

```bash
curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9000/v1/health/ready
```

**Success:** HTTP 200. Ingest can succeed while this check fails; search
cannot.

| Response | Cause | Action |
|----------|-------|--------|
| HTTP 503, `CE1 snapshot checksum mismatch` | `COSMOS_EMBED_MODELS_DIR` holds the wrong snapshot revision | Re-download the weights at the pinned revision ([Cosmos-Embed1 weights](installation.md#cosmos-embed1-weights)) |
| Connection refused | The embedder is not running | Confirm `cosmos-embed` is Healthy in `docker ps`, then start CDS again |

### Search

Use the **same collection id**:

```bash
make search \
  COLLECTION=TRAFFIC_COLLECTION_ID \
  QUERY='pedestrian crossing the road'
```

**Success:** JSON array of hits. Each hit has `id`, `score`, and `meta`
(source video, time span, clip path). Traffic first-run CE1 is often
`SDG-Intersection-02.mp4` if clip 01 was already processed with IV2 in
the same output directory.

### GA Bulk Insert

Use this only when CDS can read an `s3://` URI. Stage first. Pass
credential **environment variable names**, never secret values on the
command line:

```bash
make ingest-curator \
  CURATOR_DIR=$PWD/cookbook/traffic-video-analytics/output/split-minimal \
  OUT=$PWD/cookbook/traffic-video-analytics/output/cds-traffic.parquet \
  EMBEDDING_BACKEND=ce1

make stage-cds-artifact \
  STAGE_SOURCE=$PWD/cookbook/traffic-video-analytics/output/cds-traffic.parquet \
  STAGE_DESTINATION=s3://bucket/cds-traffic.parquet \
  OBJECT_STORE_ENDPOINT=https://objects.example

make ds-bulk-insert \
  COLLECTION=TRAFFIC_COLLECTION_ID \
  PARQUET_URI=s3://bucket/cds-traffic.parquet \
  CDS_EMBEDDING_FAMILY=ce1

make ds-job-status JOB_ID=<job-id-from-bulk-insert> WAIT=1
```

Do not treat lab document ingest (`documents:N`) as success of this path.

## Stop the Stack

```bash
make down-dataset-search
```

## If a Step Fails

| What you see | Cause | What to do |
|--------------|-------|------------|
| Pull says registry/tag not set | `.env` or `local.env` sets another `CDS_PROFILE` | Pass `CDS_PROFILE=public` and the public `1.2.0` Make arguments |
| Image is not `1.2.0` | `.env` or `local.env` sets another `CDS_PROFILE` | Down, then up with the public Make arguments |
| HTTP 500: `No pipelines have been initialised` | Cosmos-Embed1 overlay missing or image is not `1.2.0` | Start CDS with the public Make arguments and `COSMOS_EMBED_MODELS_DIR` |
| Milvus exited (1) after etcd healthy | Old Milvus + new empty etcd | Stop leftover Compose containers, then start CDS again |
| `--remove-orphans` stopped other containers | Same Compose project | Recreate those services; they are not part of Path D |
| `Connection reset by peer` on health | Gunicorn still booting | Wait loop in Wait Until the API Answers |
| `No ce1_embd_*_parquet` | `CURATOR_DIR` is the parquet folder | Use `output/split-minimal` |
| `/v1/insert-data` HTTP 404 or 400 | Local path or collection **name** | Lab ingest with collection **id** and fallback=1 |
| `/v1/collections/traffic/documents` 404 | Name used as id | Use the id from create-collection |
| `/v1/collections/TRAFFIC_COLLECTION_ID/documents` 404 | Placeholder pasted as the id | Substitute the id from create-collection |
| Search fails, ingest worked | Cosmos-Embed NIM down | Port **9000** health check |
| Search hits only clip 02 | Clip 01 skipped (old IV2 output) | Fresh `output_clip_path` and re-run Path A |
| `ds-health` 404 against a CDS on Kubernetes | `CDS_URL` missing the `/api` prefix that `FASTAPI_ROOT_PATH` and the CDS ingress expect | `export CDS_URL=https://<host>/api` |
| `ds-health` TLS error against a remote CDS | CDS bring-up issued a self-signed certificate | Point `REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE` at that certificate |
| `ds-health` fails another way | `CDS_URL` wrong, or that CDS is not up | Confirm the URL serves `/health`; bring-up belongs to the CDS repository |

Make target list: `make help`. Image pins and host limits: [Installation](installation.md).

class BulkIngestUnavailableError(RuntimeError):
    """The required CDS bulk-ingest capability is unavailable."""


class BulkJobPollingTimeout(TimeoutError):
    """CDS did not report a terminal bulk-job state before the deadline."""


def validate_cds_embedding_family(embedding_family: str) -> str:
    """Validate the declared producer family for CDS-bound vectors.

    Vector values do not identify their producer model. CDS compatibility is
    therefore an explicit operator/artifact declaration, not inferred data.
    """
    normalized = str(embedding_family or "").strip().lower()
    if normalized != CDS_COMPATIBLE_EMBEDDING_FAMILY:
        declared = normalized or "missing"
        raise ValueError(
            "CDS bulk insert requires embedding_family='ce1'; "
            f"received {declared!r}. IV2, CLIP, and SigLIP vectors are not CDS-compatible."
        )
    return normalized


def normalize_cds_base_url(base_url: str) -> str:
    """Normalize a CDS base URL so API calls land under ``/v1``.

    Accepts ``http://host:8888`` or ``http://host:8888/v1`` (with or without
    trailing slash). Raises if empty.
    """
    if not base_url or not str(base_url).strip():
        raise ValueError("base_url is required")
    cleaned = str(base_url).strip().rstrip("/")

    parsed = urlparse(cleaned)
    if not parsed.scheme or not parsed.netloc:
        raise ValueError(f"base_url must be an absolute HTTP(S) URL, got: {base_url!r}")
    if parsed.scheme not in {"http", "https"}:
        raise ValueError(f"base_url must be an absolute HTTP(S) URL, got: {base_url!r}")
    path = (parsed.path or "").rstrip("/")
    root = f"{parsed.scheme}://{parsed.netloc}"
    if path.endswith("/v1"):
        return f"{root}{path}"
    if path in ("", "/"):
        return f"{root}/v1"
    return f"{root}{path}/v1"

class BulkJobWaitPort(Protocol):
    """Port extension for polling Dataset Search bulk jobs."""

    def wait_for_job(
        self,
        job_id: str,
        *,
        timeout_seconds: float = 900.0,
        poll_interval_seconds: float = 5.0,
    ) -> BulkJobStatus:
        """Wait for one job status."""


class DatasetSearchCommandClient(
    RetrievalPort,
    IngestPort,
    SearchRefinementPort,
    BulkJobWaitPort,
    Protocol,
):
    """Dataset Search ports needed by non-trivial command workflows."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SearchQueryInput:
    """Raw search query inputs from a delivery mechanism."""

    text: str | None = None
    embedding: str | None = None
    image: str | None = None
    video: str | None = None
    video_frames: str | None = None
    top_k: int = 10
    filters_json: str | None = None
    generate_asset_url: bool = False
    annotation_labels: Sequence[str] = ()
    exclude_annotation_labels: Sequence[str] = ()
    project_source: Sequence[str] = ()
    clf_json: str | None = None
    caption_query: str | None = None
    auto_rewrite: bool | None = None
    caption_extra_queries: Sequence[str] | None = None
    classifier_label: str | None = None
    probability_expression: str | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SubmitBulkInsertRequest:
    """Inputs for submitting a Dataset Search bulk-insert job."""

    collection: str
    embedding_family: str
    parquet_paths: Sequence[str]
    access_key: str | None = None
    secret_key: str | None = None
    endpoint_url: str | None = None
    allow_lab_http_endpoint: bool = False


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class JobStatusRequest:
    """Inputs for reading or waiting for a Dataset Search job."""

    job_id: str
    wait: bool = False
    timeout_seconds: float = 900.0
    poll_interval_seconds: float = 5.0


def _search_hit_payload(hit: SearchHit) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": hit.record_id,
        "score": hit.score,
        "meta": dict(hit.metadata),
        "asset_url": hit.asset_url,
        "collection_id": hit.collection_id,
    }


def job_status_payload(status: BulkJobStatus) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Return the stable JSON payload for one Dataset Search bulk job."""
    return {
        "job_id": status.job_id,
        "status": status.status,
        "details": status.details,
        "progress": status.progress,
        "collection_name": status.collection_name,
    }


def is_failed_job_status(status: str) -> bool:
    """Return whether a normalized Dataset Search job state is failed."""
    return status.strip().lower() in _FAILED_JOB_STATES


def _parse_filters(raw_filters: str | None) -> Mapping[str, Any] | str:
    if not raw_filters:
        return {}
    try:
        filters = json.loads(raw_filters)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        return raw_filters
    if isinstance(filters, dict) or isinstance(filters, str):
        return filters
    raise ValueError("--filters-json must be a JSON object or Milvus expr string")


def build_search_query(request: SearchQueryInput) -> SearchQuery:
    """Build a domain search query from raw command inputs."""
    embedding = None
    if request.embedding:
        try:
            raw_embedding = json.loads(request.embedding)
        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
            raise ValueError(f"--embedding must be valid JSON: {exc}") from exc
        if not isinstance(raw_embedding, list):
            raise ValueError("--embedding must be a JSON array of floats")
        embedding = []
        for value in raw_embedding:
            if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
                raise ValueError("--embedding must be a JSON array of floats")
            embedding.append(float(value))
    filters = _parse_filters(request.filters_json)
    clf: Mapping[str, Any] = {}
    if request.clf_json:
        try:
            raw_clf = json.loads(request.clf_json)
        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
            raise ValueError(f"--clf-json must be valid JSON: {exc}") from exc
        if not isinstance(raw_clf, dict):
            raise ValueError("--clf-json must contain a JSON object")
        clf = raw_clf
    return SearchQuery(
        text=request.text,
        embedding=embedding,
        image=request.image,
        video=request.video,
        video_frames=request.video_frames,
        top_k=request.top_k,
        filters=filters,
        generate_asset_url=request.generate_asset_url,
        annotation_labels=tuple(request.annotation_labels),
        exclude_annotation_labels=tuple(request.exclude_annotation_labels),
        project_source=tuple(request.project_source),
        clf=clf,
        caption_query=request.caption_query,
        auto_rewrite=request.auto_rewrite,
        caption_extra_queries=(
            tuple(request.caption_extra_queries)
            if request.caption_extra_queries is not None
            else None
        ),
        classifier_label=request.classifier_label,
        probability_expression=request.probability_expression,
    )


def search_collection_handoff(
    *,
    collection: str,
    query: SearchQueryInput,
    client: DatasetSearchCommandClient,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Search within one collection and return JSON-ready hits."""
    hits = client.search(CollectionRef(collection_id=collection), build_search_query(query))
    return [_search_hit_payload(hit) for hit in hits]


def retrieve_collections_handoff(
    *,
    collections: Sequence[str],
    query: SearchQueryInput,
    rerank: bool,
    generate_asset_url: bool,
    client: DatasetSearchCommandClient,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Search across collections and return JSON-ready hits."""
    hits = client.multi_collection_search(
        MultiCollectionQuery(
            collection_ids=list(collections),
            query=build_search_query(query),
            rerank=rerank,
            generate_asset_url=generate_asset_url,
        )
    )
    return [_search_hit_payload(hit) for hit in hits]


def ingest_documents_handoff(
    *,
    collection: str,
    document_jsons: Sequence[str],
    client: DatasetSearchCommandClient,
) -> list[dict[str, str | None]]:
    """Index document specs from JSON command inputs."""
    docs: list[DocumentSpec] = []
    for raw in document_jsons:
        data = json.loads(raw)
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            raise ValueError("--document-json must contain a JSON object")
        if "mime_type" not in data:
            raise ValueError("--document-json must include mime_type")
        raw_metadata = data.get("metadata")
        if raw_metadata is not None and not isinstance(raw_metadata, dict):
            raise ValueError("--document-json metadata must be a JSON object")
        metadata = raw_metadata or {}
        docs.append(
            DocumentSpec(
                mime_type=data["mime_type"],
                content=data.get("content"),
                url=data.get("url"),
                embedding=data.get("embedding"),
                document_id=data.get("id"),
                metadata=metadata,
            )
        )
    infos = client.ingest_documents(CollectionRef(collection_id=collection), docs)
    return [{"id": doc.document_id, "indexed_at": doc.indexed_at} for doc in infos]


def delete_document_handoff(
    *,
    collection: str,
    document_id: str,
    client: DatasetSearchCommandClient,
) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Delete one document from one collection."""
    client.delete_document(CollectionRef(collection_id=collection), document_id)
    return {"deleted": document_id, "collection": collection}


def submit_bulk_insert_handoff(
    request: SubmitBulkInsertRequest,
    *,
    client: DatasetSearchCommandClient,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Submit one bulk-insert job."""
    status = client.bulk_insert(
        BulkInsertRequest(
            collection_name=request.collection,
            parquet_paths=list(request.parquet_paths),
            embedding_family=request.embedding_family.lower(),
            access_key=request.access_key,
            secret_key=request.secret_key,
            endpoint_url=request.endpoint_url,
            allow_insecure_endpoint=request.allow_lab_http_endpoint,
        )
    )
    payload = job_status_payload(status)
    payload["embedding_family"] = request.embedding_family.lower()
    return payload


def read_job_status_handoff(
    request: JobStatusRequest,
    *,
    client: DatasetSearchCommandClient,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Read or wait for one Dataset Search bulk job."""
    status = (
        client.wait_for_job(
            request.job_id,
            timeout_seconds=request.timeout_seconds,
            poll_interval_seconds=request.poll_interval_seconds,
        )
        if request.wait
        else client.get_job_status(request.job_id)
    )
    return job_status_payload(status)


def list_jobs_handoff(client: DatasetSearchCommandClient) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """List recent Dataset Search bulk jobs."""
    return {"jobs": [job_status_payload(job) for job in client.list_jobs()]}


def _load_refinement_spec(spec_file: str) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
    raw = json.loads(Path(spec_file).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        raise ValueError("--spec-file must contain a JSON object")

    grounding_queries = raw.get("grounding_queries", [])
    if not isinstance(grounding_queries, list):
        raise ValueError("grounding_queries must be a JSON array")
    if any(not isinstance(item, dict) for item in grounding_queries):
        raise ValueError("grounding_queries entries must be JSON objects")

    labels = raw.get("labels", [])
    if not isinstance(labels, list):
        raise ValueError("labels must be a JSON array")
    for label in labels:
        if not isinstance(label, dict):
            raise ValueError("labels entries must be JSON objects")
        if label.get("collection_name") is None:
            raise ValueError("labels entries must include collection_name")
        if not isinstance(label.get("labelled_documents"), dict):
            raise ValueError("labels entries must include labelled_documents object")

    return raw


def train_refinement_handoff(
    *,
    spec_file: str,
    client: DatasetSearchCommandClient,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Train search refinement from a JSON spec file."""
    raw = _load_refinement_spec(spec_file)
    grounding = [
        SearchQuery(
            text=item.get("text"),
            video=item.get("video"),
            embedding=item.get("embedding"),
        )
        for item in raw.get("grounding_queries", [])
    ]
    labels = [
        LabelledDocuments(
            collection_name=label["collection_name"],
            labelled_documents=label["labelled_documents"],
        )
        for label in raw.get("labels", [])
    ]
    result = client.train_search_refinement(
        SearchRefinementSpec(
            grounding_queries=grounding,
            labels=labels,
            model_type=raw.get("model_type", "linear_probe"),
            regularization_strength=float(raw.get("regularization_strength", 0.05)),
        )
    )
    return {
        "model_type": result.model_type,
        "queries": [list(query) for query in result.queries],
        "coef": result.coef,
        "intercept": result.intercept,
        "raw": dict(result.raw),
    }
